summary: SplitSync iteration 2 backend testing complete. All 45 pytest cases pass (21 iteration-1 regression + 24 new iteration-2 cases). Verified: Settlements CRUD + validations (invalid friend_id -> 404, amount<=0 -> 400, auth required); Groups CRUD + auto-populate split_with from group members on expense creation; Recurring create with past-dated weekly start_date materializes >=3 expenses immediately and updates next_run to future; invalid cadence rejected 400; delete works; FX endpoint returns USD/INR/EUR floats + updated_at (auth-gated); Balances now correctly subtract settlements in home currency (Alice $30 - $10 settlement = $20) and convert cross-currency expenses using live FX rate (USD expense with INR home currency returns INR-converted balances). Existing endpoints (auth/me, friends, expenses, scan Gemini 3 Flash) still pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 726 lines - approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting into routers/models/services modules in the next iteration.
materialize_recurring() runs inside GET /api/expenses on every list call. Fine for MVP but could become expensive; consider a background task or cache.

convert_amount() is called per-expense per-friend in /api/balances (N x M httpx-cached calls). Cache is process-local (_FX_CACHE) which is fine, but per-loop rate lookups still hit an async lock. Could aggregate rates once at start of balances handler.
POST /api/auth/currency only allows USD or INR, but FX endpoint and balances support EUR. Users cannot set home currency to EUR even though conversion is supported - inconsistency.
